about.title: About
about.p1: Hello! I am a Frontend Developer who loves experimenting with various things and has a strong passion for technology, especially in Artificial Intelligence (AI) and web development. I am always excited to learn new things and expand my skills in the tech world.
about.p2: I build and experiment with diverse web applications using modern technologies such as Next.js, React, TypeScript, and Tailwind CSS.
about.p3: I am consistently eager to explore emerging technologies and apply them in hands-on projects to deepen my experience and knowledge.

experience.summary: Contributed to rembox (Supporta), a multi-workspace desktop messaging application built with Electron, React, TypeScript, and SQLite. Resolved 20+ documented bugs, implemented recursive Tiles Workspace Layout, Chrome Extension (MV3) support, BrowserView lifecycle hardening, and unit + Playwright E2E QA.
